title: Suspect in fatal-stabbing of Indian man arrested in Muntinlupa

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A 50-year-old suspect allegedly involved in the fatal stabbing of an Indian businessman in Muntinlupa City was arrested, the Philippine National Police (PNP) on Tuesday said. The suspect, alias “Jun”, was apprehended by authorities of the Southern Police District, through the Muntinlupa City Police Station, after a witness reported the incident on Monday, Oct. 26. READ: 2 suspects in fatal shooting of Indian man fall in QC Based on initial investigations, Jun held the 43-year-old victim at knifepoint to rob him.
